answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond that is slashed on proven fraud, so a sybil tide of fake identities drowns in its own collateral: one honest terrace of work earns the bond back, while a thousand clones must fund a thousand bonds with no shortcut. The failure mode is bond rental, where an attacker leases stake to look solvent. Check it by tracing each bond's funding source and freezing deposits that share a funder across the horizon of new registrations, then auditing the flagged set before any bond is released.
